snippet.title: Dark Cards of Candlewood | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description: Dark Cards of Candlewood is a single-player card JRPG where you rebuild your deck after a shipwreck and fight to save a town on the edge of eternal night. Master a unique two-choice card system, chain attacks across hands, and explore randomized dungeons. Recruit companions, collect over 300 cards, and unlock new abilities by upgrading the town. No microtransactions. Just deep, rewarding card combat in a world full of mystery.
